name: pomodoro
description: A /pomodoro timer above the prompt: work and break phases, a ring at each end, and today's count shared across sessions.

pomodoroOn.title: Pomodoro · On
pomodoroOn.description: Offer the /pomodoro timer. Off: no /pomodoro command and no Pomodoro band.

pomodoroRing.title: Pomodoro · Ring
pomodoroRing.description: Play a ring when a pomodoro or a break ends. Off: the toast only. Applies from the next phase end.

pomodoroWorkMinutes.title: Pomodoro · Work minutes
pomodoroWorkMinutes.description: Length of a pomodoro, in whole minutes (1-120). Applies from the next phase that starts.

pomodoroShortBreakMinutes.title: Pomodoro · Short break minutes
pomodoroShortBreakMinutes.description: Length of a short break, in whole minutes (1-120). Applies from the next phase that starts.

pomodoroLongBreakMinutes.title: Pomodoro · Long break minutes
pomodoroLongBreakMinutes.description: Length of the long break after a full cycle, in whole minutes (1-120). Applies from the next phase that starts.

pomodoroPerCycle.title: Pomodoro · Pomodoros per cycle
pomodoroPerCycle.description: Pomodoros before a long break (2-8). Applies from the next phase that starts.
